title: Xavier and Sadie Herbert's Cottage

terrainReference.basis: Original elevation between the front verandah and Kamerunga Road.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap and Queensland Heritage Register GIS
mapIdentity.scope: The state heritage parcel bounds the cottage beside the Red Beret Hotel and opposite the station. The road-facing polygon edge supplies frontage and orientation. The written cottage profile guides subdivision of the longer mapped roof.

note: The Queensland Heritage Register records a single-storey low-stump cottage, enclosed front and rear verandahs, corrugated hipped roof, aluminium weatherboard-like cladding, front lattice, east skillion garage and concrete block rear addition.
